lines.en: Flowers sway on my back; every step smells sweet.
I cross the meadow and flowers open.

lines.zh: 背上这丛黄，是我的招牌
lines.en: This yellow cluster on my back is my mark.

lines.zh: 慢悠悠地吃草，边吃边走
lines.en: Grazing as I go, unhurried.
Bees always follow me.
The soil in the flower forest is soft.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，花也跟着摇
lines.en: I sway, and the flowers sway.

lines.zh: 我身上的花，不摘也不掉
lines.en: The flowers on me are neither picked nor fallen.
Chewing cud while I walk.

Bees rest on my back.

lines.zh: 我这一身，算是个移动花坛
lines.en: I'm a walking flower bed.

A butterfly rests on my flower.
I swish my tail at the flies.

lines.zh: 这些花从哪来的，我也说不清
lines.en: Where these flowers came from, I can't say.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我浑身都是香的
lines.en: One breeze and I'm all fragrance.
Standing here, I pollinate.
This patch has the most flowers.

lines.zh: 我哞一声，远处的牛应了
lines.en: I low, and a distant cow answers.
Flowers blooming on my back; I'm at ease.
The idlest thing in this meadow is me.

lines.zh: 我不爱动，动起来花会掉
lines.en: I don't like moving; the flowers might fall.

lines.zh: 别碰那些花，它们是我的
lines.en: Don't touch those flowers; they're mine.

Few visitors come to the flower forest.

lines.zh: 我看你像个会摘花的人
lines.en: You look like a flower-picker.

lines.zh: 我背上的黄，衬得你脸色不好
lines.en: My yellow makes you look pale.

I stepped back; the flowers remain.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我背上的一片花瓣
lines.en: You knocked a petal off my back.
Even cowhide won't stop that.
The bees all scattered.

lines.zh: 我这一身花，可不能沾血
lines.en: I can't have blood on these flowers.

lines.zh: 疼得我把头上的花都甩乱了。
lines.en: The pain shakes my head flowers loose.
Don't tread on those flowers.
I lowed for a long time.
Wheat? I do like that.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，我看到了
lines.en: I see that grass in your hand.
I'll follow, just don't step on flowers.
I eat slowly; don't rush me.
A little closer; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 花森林的草也有这种味
lines.en: The grass here has this scent too.
Eating as I walk, scattering flowers.
The bees will follow your hand.
This mouthful lasts me a while.
You bumped the flowers on my back.
This body is solid.
Step aside; the flowers will fall.

lines.zh: 撞一下，蜜蜂全飞起来了
lines.en: One bump and the bees all take off.
Steady hooves; I won't be knocked over.
You bounced off, didn't you?
Don't push; I'm heavy.
Two petals fell; a pity.
No walls in a meadow; what did you hit?
I'm turning slowly; step clear.
These flowers on me are for you.

lines.zh: 花森林里，两头牛并排走
lines.en: Two cows side by side in the flower forest.
Let's graze this meadow down together.
The bees will follow us both.
Come close; don't knock the flowers off.
One low means yes.
The meadow is big enough for both.
Flowers will bloom on both our backs.
You lead; I'll follow.
This patch is loveliest in bloom.

Head down, and my mouth has more grass.

lines.zh: 我把它放在背上的花里
lines.en: I tuck it among my flowers.
Just right for my head.
Fallen petals shouldn't be wasted.
Chewing slowly, no hurry.
That flower on the ground, I know it.
Petals everywhere; I can't gather them all.

I fix on you and low.

lines.zh: 你踩坏的花，一朵一朵算
lines.en: We'll count every flower you crushed.

No cover in this meadow.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，花掉了一半
lines.en: I rolled downhill and lost half the flowers.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，花香都散了
lines.en: Water up to my neck; the fragrance washed away.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我背上的花丛
lines.en: Something struck the flowers on my back.

lines.zh: 雷打在犄角上，麻到蹄子
lines.en: Lightning hit my horns and numbed me to the hooves.
